_note: One icon per ARCHETYPE, not per pack: a pack is not an archetype, since 6,184 tabler icons are one monochrome shape while five metronic logos are five different problems. Entries with a `source` are real corpus icons from public packs, copied here because core cannot depend on the sibling packs; sha256 records which upstream file each came from, so a refresh is detectable. Entries with `synthetic: true` have no upstream: they replace icons from Metronic (proprietary artwork) and icon-sets-bundled (a private pack since 2026-10-26, not redistributable), which must not ship in this public repository. Each was hand-written to carry the same constructs as the icon it replaced, so the test proves the same thing; sha256 there is of the fixture itself.

gradient.replaces: a Metronic brand logo (proprietary; removed from this public repo)
gradient.constructs: two linearGradients (2 and 3 stops, offsets, gradientUnits=userSpaceOnUse) painted through fill="url(#id)"; a clipPath applied through clip-path="url(#id)"; author-style ids the namespacing pass must rewrite at both ends; root width/height beside a viewBox for sizing normalisation
gradient.proves: linearGradient + <stop>: a gradient with no stops paints nothing; and every url(#id) still resolves after ids are namespaced

use-fragment.proves: <use href="#..."> sprite: 126 flag icons render as nothing without it

inline-style.replaces: a Metronic flag icon (proprietary; removed from this public repo)
inline-style.constructs: an Illustrator-style export: XML prolog with iso-8859-1 encoding, a comment, root id="Layer_1" with x/y, xml:space and style="enable-background:..."; every paint is style="fill:...;" on rect, path and polygon, with no fill attribute anywhere; nested and empty <g>; transform="matrix(...)"
inline-style.proves: style="fill:..." is the ONLY paint source for 261 of 501 metronic icons

title.replaces: a clarity-icons icon from icon-sets-bundled (MIT upstream, but the pack is private since 2026-10-26; removed from this public repo)
title.constructs: a single-line export: xmlns plus an unused xmlns:xlink, version="1.1", a 36x36 viewBox with no width/height, preserveAspectRatio, fill="currentColor" on the root; a <title> as the first child; three <path>s with multi-token class attributes and compound subpaths (Z then m/H/V); a full-size <rect> with fill-opacity="0" as the hit area
title.proves: <title> is the accessible name; 6,966 bundled icons carry one

control.proves: the archetype the policy was designed against: must never change
